title: Publish a ready batch through the approval gatekeeper flow
description: This test verifies that a ready batch can be reviewed, accepted, approved, and published through the four-eyes gatekeeper flow.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file
Resolve all exceptions in the batch
Verify the publication confirmation is visible

title: Import a DSP report and leave it in draft after matching
description: This test verifies that an admin can select a DSP platform, preview parsed rows, run matching, and end with a draft batch that is not yet visible to creators.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file
Verify a draft confirmation is visible

title: Publish a ready batch through approval
description: This test verifies that a ready batch can be published only after completing the checklist, reviewing the snapshot, selecting an eligible approver, and accepting the declaration.

steps.description: Open the publish flow for a ready batch
Review the checklist and snapshot summary
Accept the declaration and confirm publication
Verify the batch is marked as published

title: Resolve an unmatched row and reach ready status
description: This test verifies that an unmatched DSP row can be mapped correctly and that the ready banner appears once all issues are cleared.

steps.description: Filter exceptions by a failure stage
Open an unmatched row for resolution
Map the row to the correct song or creator
Verify the ready banner is visible

title: Keep unmatched royalties out of publishable state
description: This test verifies that unresolved unmatched or conflicting rows remain in an exception state and do not produce a ready batch.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file with exceptions
Verify the batch is not ready for publication

title: Reject publication when the checklist is incomplete
description: This test verifies that a batch cannot be published until the required readiness checklist is complete.

steps.description: Open the publish flow for a batch that is not ready
Attempt to continue without a complete checklist
Verify a checklist validation message is visible

title: Show only published or locked statements in the creator portal
description: This test verifies that a creator can switch account view, select a period, and see only published or locked royalty statements with the correct verification state.

steps.description: Switch to a creator account view
Verify only published or locked royalty statements are displayed
Verify a verification banner is visible when the period is under review or unverified

title: Resolve a royalty exception with a required reason
description: This test verifies that an unresolved row can be placed on hold or ignored only after providing the required reason and the batch progresses toward readiness.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file with exceptions
Choose an unmatched row to resolve
Place the row on hold or ignore it
Verify the batch is closer to ready for publication

title: Unpublish a published batch with a valid reason
description: This test verifies that a published batch can be rolled back after entering a valid reason and reviewing the affected creator information.

steps.description: Open the unpublish flow for a published batch
Enter a reason that meets the minimum length requirement
Verify the batch returns to ready-to-publish status

title: Filter and inspect creator results in the admin dashboard
description: This test verifies that an admin can change the reporting period, search or sort creators, and open a creator row to inspect details.

steps.description: Search or sort the creator list
Verify the selected period remains applied

title: Hold or ignore a row with a required reason
description: This test verifies that a row can be placed on hold or ignored only after entering a required reason and that the exception is cleared afterward.

steps.description: Filter exceptions by a failure stage
Open a row that needs manual handling
Choose to put the row on hold or ignore it
Verify the row is no longer open
Verify the reasoned resolution is reflected

title: Block publication until the checklist is complete
description: This test verifies that a batch cannot be published while required checklist items are incomplete and that the UI keeps it in a non-publishable state.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file
Attempt to proceed to publication with the checklist incomplete
Verify a checklist validation warning is visible

title: Lock a published period
description: This test verifies that a published batch can be permanently closed as a locked period.

steps.description: Verify the batch is marked as locked

title: Review gross and net royalties in the creator portal
description: This test verifies that a creator can inspect gross and net royalty amounts for a selected period.

steps.description: Switch to a creator account view
Verify gross royalty amounts are displayed
Verify net royalty amounts are displayed

title: Preview parsed report rows before matching
description: This test verifies that an uploaded DSP report shows a parsed row preview before the distribution engine is run.

steps.description: Upload a valid royalty report file
Verify the batch is still in draft

title: Cancel a draft batch
description: This test verifies that a draft batch can be cancelled and is shown as cancelled afterward.

steps.description: Verify the batch is marked as cancelled

title: Download a creator statement as CSV
description: This test verifies that a creator can download the currently viewed statement data as CSV from the portal.

steps.description: Switch to a creator account view
Verify the statement download action is available
Verify the currently selected period remains visible

title: Require a minimum-length reason to unpublish
description: This test verifies that the unpublish flow blocks submission until the reason meets the minimum length requirement.

steps.description: Open the unpublish flow for a published batch
Enter a short reason that is below the minimum length
Verify a reason validation message is visible

title: Block hold or ignore without a reason
description: This test verifies that manual exception handling cannot be completed until a required reason is provided.

steps.description: Filter exceptions by a failure stage
Open a row that needs manual handling
Choose to put the row on hold or ignore it
Attempt to confirm without entering a reason
Verify a required reason validation message is visible

title: Review batch status badges and audit logs
description: This test verifies that batch lifecycle badges and audit history are visible for operational review.

steps.description: Verify batch status badges are displayed
